Pocket Notch needs permission to read and control the current track in Music or Spotify when system media metadata is unavailable.
Pocket Notch captures system audio only while music is playing to render the notch spectrum visualizer. Audio is analyzed on-device and never recorded, stored, or transmitted.

Pocket Notch captures the wallpaper behind the lock-screen music widget to render its Glass and Clear refraction effects. Captured pixels are processed locally and never recorded, stored, or transmitted.
Pocket Notch detects Bluetooth accessory connections to show the device icon and battery status beside the notch.
Pocket Notch uses your approximate location only when weather monitoring is enabled to show current conditions beside the notch.
